Expand II and ADDL with NONMEM-like methods for a single subject

realize_addl_single.Rd

Expand II and ADDL with NONMEM-like methods for a single subject

Usage

realize_addl_single(time, evid, addl = 0, ii = 0)

Arguments

time

Time of assessment

evid

NONMEM-style event identifier; 1 is a dose; 4 is a reset and dose; all other rows are ignored.

addl

The number of additional doses (0 indicates one dose will be administered)

ii

The interdose-interval (time between doses)

Value

A data.frame with rows expanded based on addl and ii. The final number of rows will be sum(evid c(1, 4)])
